html:
A battle near Kumasi in 1701 in which the new Asante union of Osei Tutu defeated Denkyira, the Akan kingdom that had ruled over it.

Denkyira had controlled the trade routes to the coast and the Dutch and English forts. Its king Ntim Gyakari was killed, and Asante took its lands, its gold and its trade, including the Dutch "note" or rent for Elmina. Feyiase is remembered as the birth of the Asante Empire, and the Golden Stool tradition is tied to this war. See also the Akan.
